title: OpenBrain Sync Undoing
description: Written as <batch_id>.undoing.json under 10_memory/staging/batches/ before `open-brain sync undo` puts back its first file, and replaced by <batch_id>.undone.json once the last one is back. It names what is already restored, so a reversal interrupted halfway is resumed instead of refused for a drift it caused itself. Mutable and short lived, unlike every other document the gate writes.

restored.description: Vault-relative paths already written back to their pre-batch bytes.

removed.description: Vault-relative paths the batch had created and that are already deleted.
